    • copyWithReliabilityInputs

      public SafetyFunctionDesign.Subsystem copyWithReliabilityInputs(double dangerousFailureRate, double coverage, double proofInterval, double repairTime, double beta, double bypass)
      Copies the subsystem while replacing uncertain reliability inputs.
      Parameters:
      dangerousFailureRate - sampled dangerous failure rate in 1/h
      coverage - sampled diagnostic coverage
      proofInterval - sampled proof-test interval in hours
      repairTime - sampled mean repair time in hours
      beta - sampled common-cause beta factor
      bypass - sampled probability of bypass on demand
      Returns:
      subsystem copy retaining proof-test, PST, mission, architecture, and evidence settings
